title: Speed Test Upload, VPN Lifecycle & Stability Update
message: Fixed Speed Test upload accuracy (4x server-acknowledged HTTP/1.1 POST chunks with 1.3s warmup discard, 1s sliding window, and instant SO_LINGER socket abort), hardened Android 8+ VPN foreground lifecycle & error handling, improved Xray TLS Fragment/VMess/Shadowsocks/Hotspot routing, added share-to-import support, offloaded QR/Hotspot I/O off the main thread, and added live server switching and Open Source Licenses.
